reviews.title: great fans
reviews.comment: used these for H6 flow case, work great, look great. Daisy chain built into the fans so you only have to use 1 ARGB and 1 PWM if you want to you dont have to daisy chain you could use them separate if needed. Max fan speed was about 1800RPM on full power on the 140mm. Since it is forcing me to review both the 140mm 2 pack, the 120mm 3 pack, and a single 120mm fan all in one because they are different variants, i will mention them as well. the 120mm fans are great, a little loud when at 100% but the RPM max is 2100-2180, so yea its not going to be quiet lol, they are PWM 4 pin, also have daisy chain option built in, one of the products i forget which maybe the 3 pack came with 2 ARGB and 2 PWM extensions which can be useful, i had to set up the fans "sideways" not that you can tell, because the wire placement was in the way for the wire channel when upright position. What i did so the fans were not on top of another's wires was took the wires out the little holder and that gave just enough slack to not have the wires under the fan and the wires were no where near the fan blades after. I went from nzxt to these, nzxt had a lower rpm rate on both 140 and 120s, therefor was more quiet, but i am fine with the noise, i have a headset on 90% of the time im using the PC lol. So crank away. 5 star on all products, would recommend, good quality, high RPMs, ARGB!, style is great, would 100% recommend the 120mm fans to put on a radiator as they have a high rpm and push pretty good, the 120 fans on my cooler master max rpm is like 1800 so i almost want to swap them for the extra pressure.
reviews.author: Nate

reviews.title: Very Nice Fans
reviews.comment: These are really nice fans. Airflow and rotation directions are clearly marked. They work well with motherboard ARGB control or with a discrete ARGB string controller. The PWM and ARGB connections can be daisy chained to control 2 or 3 fans from a single PWM and ARGB header. The colors look great and definitely get bright enough. They move plenty of air when they need to, and are whisper quiet when operating at low and even moderate speed. I've used them in two different cases recently with no problems, they fit well where a 120mm x 25mm fan is expected to go. The three fans come with standard black mounting screws and with two additional ARGB extension cables and two additional PWM extension cables.
reviews.author: KGB

reviews.title: Function fashion and easy setup
reviews.comment:
absolutely love these Corsair RGB fans. The ability to daisy chain the connections makes cable management so much easier and keeps my build looking clean and organized. Installation was straightforward, and everything synced up perfectly.
They look incredible in my white case—the lighting is vibrant, evenly diffused, and really elevates the overall aesthetic of my PC. Performance has been great as well, with solid airflow and quiet operation.
Highly recommend these fans if you want great performance, easy setup, and top-tier RGB visuals.
reviews.author: Shannon harte

reviews.title: Short power and RGB leads—beware!
reviews.comment: Replaced a couple fractal aspect 120s with these 140s and my CPU temp at full load dropped by 5+ degrees, from mid 80s to high 70s (5800x3d with a Thermaltake Fs 140).  They’re just about dead silent at idle and audible but tolerable at higher RPMs, no annoying whine or whistle with these just a rush of air.  Wanted RGB for the kids and the colors and diffusion look fine to my eye.  These are pricey however they don’t have rubber pads at the mount holes and they have comically short power and RGB cables which caused an additional purchase of 4 pin extension cables.  A nice long RGB cable on my 120mm thermalright cpu fan had a daisy chain part to it and is the only reason I could finish the build without RGB extension cables.  So these aren’t perfect but they’re fair quality with decent overall performance.  Hope they last!
